name: Harukoi * Otome ~Otome no Sono de Gokigen'you.~
original_name: 春恋＊乙女～乙女の園でごきげんよう。～
source: Harukoi Otome revolves around protagonist Akihito Hayasaka, a male high-school sophomore. The high school he attends St. Francesca Academy used to be an all-girls school, and still has a high percentage of female students. Akihito's younger sister (Umi Hayasaka) and his childhood friend (Yuika Serizawa) are also students there. Akihito meets many girls there, and becomes friends with them.
